page.layout: One page of text, full width, no margin notes. Top: page number 628. Running text in roman with italic names and phrases. Below the text: a Syriac passage of seven lines, set as a display block. Last line in italic, then the catchword "vos" at the right.

p.i: Arsacium Constantinopolitanum, Ioannem Constantinopolitanum, Theophilum Alexandrinum, Amphilochium Iconij, Cyprianum Carthaginensem, Irenaeum Lugdunensem, Methodium Olympiadis, Ephrem Doctorem, Isaac Doctorem &c. His volumus adhaereatis, & amplexemini, eorumque doctrinas puras, & probatas diligatis, & amplectamini, quicquid praestiterunt in Ecclesia sancta Dei ab eorum ortu usque ad finem vitae, sive in Canonibus, sive in scriptionibus, sive in Decisionibus, sive in excommunicationibus.

main_text.p: Et post aliqua iubet, ut subscribant Homologiam, & signum Crucis imprimant, iterumque subdit;

p.i: Quoniam ecce coram Deo protestor aduersus

page.notes: The Syriac passage (seven lines, centred display block) could not be read letter by letter, so each line is marked illegible with an estimated letter count. The letter counts are approximate. The Latin italic names are copied as printed, with long s written as plain s. The dot at the right edge of the last text line and the stains at the margins are not printed text and are left out.
